name: munit-test-payload
description: The IT POSTs 'test' to / and reads exactly 'test' from sales_queue (published through sales_exchange). Nobody replies, so the request-response call times out and the HTTP response carries no AMQP result.

source.reference: sending-json-data-to-a-amqp-queue/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/SendingJsonDataToAmqpQueueIT.java (dispatch 'test' over HTTP POST; basicGet on sales_queue equals 'test'); src/main/app/json-to-rabbitmq.xml (amqp:outbound-endpoint exchangeName=sales_exchange queueName=sales_queue exchange-pattern=request-response responseTimeout=10000)
